rules.development_source: Fetch the public funding-history API separately for each authorized symbol and UTC evaluation day, validate and seal canonical bytes, and never request a locked-validation day during development.
rules.event_validation: Require a non-empty, unique, chronological, same-symbol, same-UTC-day response with finite funding rates and positive mark prices.
rules.accounting: For each event in [entry, exit), funding portfolio PnL is the negative sum of position weight multiplied by funding rate; positive rates are paid by longs and received by shorts.
rules.final_reconciliation: After locked validation is legitimately opened, reconcile the complete 180-day daily API set to Binance monthly fundingRate ZIP files and publisher CHECKSUMs before any final verdict.
rules.unreconciled_result: Development may be evaluated provisionally, but no locked-validation PASS or promotion review may use unreconciled funding.
